name: feature-regression
title: Feature regression and evidence handoff
description: Reusable regression workflow for feature, bug-fix, and investigation requests. Produces bounded scenarios, raw evidence, deterministic oracle verdicts, replay data, and a triage report; it never treats missing capability as PASS.

stages.title: Discovery and intake
stages.prompt: Normalize the request into changed surfaces, expected behavior, non-goals, available test capabilities, evidence policy, and acceptance criteria. Do not invent repository facts; mark assumptions and capability gaps.

stages.title: Map affected surfaces
stages.prompt: Inspect the repository and relevant runtime/test adapters. Map changed files, symbols, routes, resources, permissions, shared components, and entry points to stable surface references. Include source evidence, confidence, and inferred mappings.

stages.title: Assess blast radius
stages.prompt: Independently assess reachable neighbors, timing/state risks, platform or environment variants, failure modes, and priority. Use bounded depth/fan-out and record missing data; scoring prioritizes exploration and is not proof of absence.

stages.title: Prepare scenario plan
stages.prompt: Turn the surface map and blast-radius evidence into a deterministic, bounded scenario plan. Each scenario must define preconditions, typed actions, observations, expected oracle evidence, seed, environment, budget, destructive-action policy, and cleanup.

stages.title: User checkpoint
stages.prompt: Present the bounded scenario plan and unresolved capability or safety gaps. If autonomous, continue with the bounded plan and record that decision; never silently enable destructive actions or external upload.
stages.autonomous: continue with the bounded scenario plan and record the decision

stages.title: Capture baseline
stages.prompt: Prepare or capture baseline evidence before executing candidate scenarios. Preserve build/source revision, environment, fixture, seed, collectors, redaction decisions, and capability gaps. Raw evidence is authoritative; model prose cannot replace it.

stages.title: Execute approved scenarios
stages.prompt: Reset/checkpoint, capture before-action evidence, perform one typed action, wait on explicit predicates, and capture post-action evidence. Keep retries as separate attempts with stable action IDs and unique attempt IDs. Fail closed for unavailable safety or evidence controls.

stages.title: Check transient and animation states
stages.prompt: Evaluate transient, animation, race, accessibility, geometry, and timing requirements using instrumented events when available and pixels/video only as best-effort support. Missing instrumentation or ambiguous sampling is inconclusive, never PASS.

stages.title: Evaluate against oracle
stages.prompt: Apply deterministic functional, semantic/accessibility, visual, temporal, performance, reliability, network, security/privacy, and matrix oracles. PASS requires required evidence and no unresolved capability gap; FAIL requires contradictory evidence; otherwise use inconclusive.

stages.title: Replay candidate failures
stages.prompt: Replay every candidate failure using the preserved build, source revision, seed, action prefix, environment constraints, timing mode, contract version, and redaction policy. Preserve raw evidence and report reproducibility or replay gaps.

stages.title: Deduplicate and triage
stages.prompt: Group findings by stable failure signature without deleting raw evidence. Label confirmed, false-positive, flaky, baseline, or new finding; assign severity, confidence, evidence references, unresolved gaps, and recommended next action.

stages.title: Summary and handoff
stages.prompt: Summarize scope, scenarios, evidence, verdicts, replay results, triage, capability gaps, security/redaction controls, and explicit limitations. Do not claim coverage or correctness beyond observed evidence.
